description: VS Code: requested_tools comes from the tool_call parts of the chat span's gen_ai.output.messages (a JSON string), counted by tool name across all messages. Output messages without tool calls (text and reasoning parts only, or an empty array) give an empty object; a span without gen_ai.output.messages (content capture off) leaves the field out. Only tool names are read: text, arguments and call ids (marked CONTENT-SENTINEL) never reach a record.
